headline: Four Fronts Register Fresh Ownership Changes
war_summary: Since the last edition, ownership has shifted in four regions. Nevish Line has gone from seven Colonial bases and one neutral to all eight Colonial, though its event ledger has been quiet for two hours. Mooring County now stands at 10 Warden bases and two Colonial, against 11 and one before; no events were logged in the latest two hours. Weathered Expanse has moved from seven Warden and two neutral to six Warden and three neutral, with two event rows in the latest two hours. Marban Hollow is now three Warden, three Colonial and two neutral, and its ledger recorded five rows in those same two hours, the latest at 02:45 UTC. Callum’s Cape also shows recent action: three event rows in two hours leave its current count at six Warden bases and one Colonial. Callahan’s Passage remains entirely Warden-held, with no events in two hours. The war is undecided; 34 victory towns are required.
